# Foooverse — app documentation

Public documentation for apps published by **foooverse**, served by GitHub Pages and linked
from the apps' Atlassian Marketplace listings.

**Live:** <https://foojisheep.github.io/app-docs/>

One folder per app. Each folder holds that app's overview, documentation, user guide,
support, security statement and privacy policy.

---

## Do not edit the HTML in this repo

**These pages are generated.** Each app keeps its documentation as markdown in its own
source repository, and a build step renders it into the HTML committed here.

Editing a page here means the next regeneration silently overwrites your change — and the
app's own repository goes on describing behaviour the published page no longer matches. A
privacy policy that disagrees with the product is a real problem, not a cosmetic one.

**To change a page:** edit the markdown in the app's source repository, regenerate, and copy
the output here.

---

## Adding an app

Create a folder named after the app and copy its generated pages in.

---

## Why these pages exist

An Atlassian Marketplace listing requires publicly reachable URLs for the privacy policy,
support and documentation. They must be live before a listing is submitted, and stay live
for as long as the app is listed — a dead privacy-policy link is grounds for a listing to be
pulled.

Hosting them here keeps them free, versioned, and separate from the application source,
which stays private.
